source.title: Sergey Ryabko wins European Rubik's Cube Championship 2012
source.content:
[Sergey Ryabko](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009RYAB01) won the [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2012](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2012) with an average of 8.89 seconds. [Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01) finished second (9.21) and [Michał Pleskowicz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009PLES01) finished third (9.24).  
 World records: Marcell Endrey 3x3 blindfolded 26.36 (single).  
 European records: Michał Pleskowicz 2x2 Cube 2.22 (average), Bence Barát 7x7 Cube 3:08.43 (single) 3:18.54 (average), Henrik Buus Aagaard 3x3 with feet 39.02 (average), Simon Crawford Square-1 11.76 (average).

translation.title: Sergey Ryabko 获得 2012 年欧洲魔方锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Sergey Ryabko](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009RYAB01) 以 8.89 秒的平均成绩获得 [2012 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2012)冠军。[Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01) 以 9.21 秒获得亚军，[Michał Pleskowicz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009PLES01) 以 9.24 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Marcell Endrey，三阶盲拧单次 26.36 秒。

欧洲纪录：Michał Pleskowicz，二阶平均 2.22 秒；Bence Barát，七阶单次 3:08.43、平均 3:18.54；Henrik Buus Aagaard，三阶脚拧平均 39.02 秒；Simon Crawford，Square-1 平均 11.76 秒。
